title: Fleshrender

sources.title: Part the Flesh
markers: | description = Thrust forward with diabolical precision, possibly stymying your target's ability to heal.

summary: A +2 shortsword with Part the Flesh.

fields.Part the Flesh: Action once per Short Rest. Make a melee weapon attack and add Necrotic damage equal to proficiency bonus. Constitution save against weapon action DC +2 or Rended Flesh for 3 turns, preventing healing.
fields.Acquisition: Echo of Abazigal sells it if you become an Unholy Assassin of Bhaal.
fields.Base value: 190 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay use and reviewed pinned source evidence.
